rule_title: TTP T1484.001 - Domain Policy Modified by Non-System Account (EID 4739)
description: Detects EID 4739 (domain policy change) where the actor is a named user account rather than SYSTEM or a DC machine account. EID 4739 fires whenever the domain-wide account/password policy, lockout policy, or Kerberos policy is modified. Legitimate changes originate from SYSTEM (S-1-5-18) or DC machine accounts during Group Policy application — never from interactive human accounts directly. A named user modifying domain policy directly indicates either a compromised privileged account or deliberate policy weakening (e.g. reducing password complexity, extending MaxPasswordAge, disabling lockout thresholds) to prepare for brute force or persistence.
